title: Option Alpha Community
author: Weak-Ad-2373
selftext:
I've been building and backtesting bots on Option Alpha for a few weeks, mostly short premium on SPX and SPY. Most of that time has gone into learning that the hard part isn't building the bot — it's working out whether the results mean anything.

Putting together a small Discord for people who are actually running OA bots and want to talk methodology — backtest design, ablation testing, cost modeling, that kind of thing. Not signals, not a paid group, no picks. Just people comparing notes on what actually holds up.

If that sounds useful, DM me and I'll send an invite.
